source: Measured by ale validate on the nine-clip task: validate-5894a231, validate-277fea36, validate-7ff7879f and validate-a581fa34 (clips replayed one after another), and validate-e19240e5 (the same per-clip replays, four at a time), oracle result.json: mean_clip_score=1.0 in all five runs, every clip 1.0 over 4 perturbed replays each (36 replays per run). The fixed-seed replay is deterministic and each clip keeps its own scene, so the runs agree exactly; full_at 0.95 leaves margin for one replay drifting on other hardware.
